# Soboly

> > Soboly is a privacy-focused search engine providing anonymous, ad-free search without tracking or data collection, primarily serving users in Ukraine, Russia, and Central Asia.

Soboly emphasizes user privacy and data protection while delivering search results across diverse topics including emergency alerts, educational institutions, and regional services. The platform serves as an alternative to mainstream search engines for users seeking confidential browsing experiences.

## Key Topics

- Privacy-focused search
- Anonymous browsing
- No tracking policy
- Ad-free search engine
- Data protection
- Ukraine air raid alerts
- Real-time threat monitoring
- Missile and drone tracking
- Emergency alert systems
- Educational institution search
- Regional service discovery
- Confidential search results
- User privacy protection

## Core Platform

- [Soboly - Безопасная и конфиденциальная поисковая система](https://soboly.com/): Privacy-focused search engine without tracking, ads, or manipulation

## Emergency & Safety Search Results

- [онлайн карта ракетної небезпеки](https://soboly.com/онлайн-карта-ракетної-небезпеки): Search results for Ukraine missile threat maps and air raid alerts

## Educational & Regional Services

- [расписание улгпу](https://soboly.com/расписание-улгпу): Search results for Ulyanovsk State Pedagogical University schedule
- [oqulabs almau](https://soboly.com/oqulabs-almau): Search results for OquLabs student monitoring at AlmaU university

## Commerce & Events

- [autowebdirect](https://soboly.com/autowebdirect): Search results for Japanese car export and auction sites
- [мос слон фестиваль](https://soboly.com/мос-слон-фестиваль): Search results for Moscow festival and cultural events
